scene: The brass gent tips his bowler hat and presents three curious items.
picture: Side-scrolling view on wet cobbles. On the left stands Granny in pink tracksuit holding her dog's leash. At centre, the brass gent tips his hat, holding out a winged key, tucking a map under his arm, and dangling a ticking pocket watch. On the right, a glowing lamppost illuminates a stone archway.
shown: a gleaming winged key held in the robot gent's outstretched left hand
an intricate parchment map tucked beneath the gent's right metallic arm
a ticking golden pocket watch dangling from the gent's shiny bronze vest
